😍Morocco like Pinterest: the most beautiful hotels  🇲🇦  📍 Royal Mansour Marrakech One of the most luxurious hotels in the world, where every guest stays in a private riad with its own courtyard and pool. Carved ceilings, mosaics, and palm gardens. Breakfasts on the terrace and a spa under a glass dome. 📍 El Fenn A place where Morocco meets contemporary art. Bright walls, terracotta rooftop pools, vintage furniture, and rich colors. A bohemian vibe with sunsets overlooking the medina. 📍 La Mamounia A true Marrakech legend. Expansive gardens, arched galleries, emerald tiles, and a pool you’ll want to spend all day in. Classic luxury with history. 📍 Riad Yasmine The iconic Instagram riad with an emerald pool and pink walls. Small, cozy, and incredibly photogenic. Breakfast by the pool with flower petals. 📍 Amanjena Minimalism with Moroccan architecture. Sandy tones, reflective pools, and perfect symmetry. 📍 Kasbah Tamadot A hotel in the Atlas Mountains with views over the valleys. Terraces, Berber style, and warm sunset light. 📍 The Oberoi Marrakech Modern luxury with an oriental touch. Grand pools, arches, reflective water, and clean geometry. 📍 Scarabeo Camp White tents in the Agafay desert. Minimalism, sand dunes, camels, and caramel-colored sunsets. #moroccotravel #luxuryhotels #riadlife #travelinspo #bucketlist

5 things to know before going to Marrakech👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Moroccan taxis WILL overcharge you, download @inDrive before you arrive. It works at the airport, you set your own price, so there’s no negotiation needed 🚖  2️⃣ Be aware of the animal abuse at Jemaa el-Fnaa. Men walk the square with monkeys in chains and snakes with their teeth removed, don’t pay if they confront you 🙊  3️⃣ Where you stay matters. I found my riad on the @cozycozy app, which compared the prices across all the major booking sites. Agoda was £40 vs £45 on Booking.com, saving £35 over 7 nights 🏨  4️⃣ Eat all the street food. Vendors need licences, so it’s clean, fresh and cheap. I reccoemnd trying this sardine salad just off the main square, search “fried fish” on google maps 🍗  5️⃣ Stay safe in the medina. Wear your backpack on your front, watch out for pickpockets, ignore the men on street corners and download offline maps before you arrive 🎒  Save this video for your trip to Morocco 📌 #marrakech #morocco #jemaaelfna #cozycozy #ad
